title: Customize your site re-checks a release when the inputs it was judged with change (rules, own profile rows, contract), keeps the last result with Rechecking meanwhile, and sends each fix to where its file lives
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a Postgres the tests may use, run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/customize-readiness.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/road-to-live.test.mjs.
expect: S1: every test passes, including: checked while the profile row was missing gives STAB-1 must-fix, and after the row is added the next sweep re-checks it automatically and it is clean, with the last result and recheckingSince shown meanwhile and the other template not re-checked; a rules change re-checks every release; Check again keeps the last result until the new one lands; a re-checking step keeps its state and the publish refusal.

S2: every test passes, including the last result plus a Rechecking note with no Check again button, and the prompt sending a contract fix to the tch repository, a JA template fix to ja-products and an EmDash template fix to packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-<name>.

S3: every test passes, including ABOUT-3 owner contract on Joomla and WordPress and template on EmDash, owner contract for a missing contract, and for every rule and platform: every file a fix names is classified, exists in tch when it is a tch file, is named only on a platform that has it (or qualified by its CMS), and the owner sends the reader to where it lives.
evidence: 12/10/2026 on dev: Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.16 was checked before the image with its template-profiles.json row was deployed; six must-fix rules stayed until Check again gave 27/27. The ABOUT-3 prompt for tracy-business/wp7 1.3.4 sent the fix to ja-products although demoCompanyNames is in the contract's 1.3.4.copy.json in tch.
fence: A stored result records the version of every input it was judged with; the sweep compares them with the server's own and re-checks only the affected releases, while Publish keeps reading the last result
